sentence: A headcount poll where each person answers in, maybe or out, with an optional short note, and the event locks once enough people are in.
use_when: Checking who is coming to a game, meetup or outing
An event needs a minimum number of people to go ahead
Everyone should see live answers and a count toward the minimum
People want to add a short note like running late
dont_use_when: Choosing between several options or times, which needs a vote or schedule poll
Splitting costs or tracking who owes what
Assigning people to teams or roles
